method: For each of 88 source-backed numeric blueprint links, resolve independently decoded blueprint→Tier-I gear→gun_no, exact indexed gun-base row and unique typed final suffix. Parse only two bounded prefix shapes and float32/64 paths whose decoded values are finite, 0..100, and either zero or at least 0.0001; require every independently ADS/bullet-anchored path surviving this domain filter to agree on target fields/type/bytes. Parse burst count and mode from ordered native descriptor, and trigger from unique terminal typed tail. Do not promote 33 unsupported/ambiguous rows.
identity_gate: The 88 links include exact public-name links and source-backed proposals from the crosswalk packet. This artifact does not assert that all proposals were accepted into Forge. The 55 records are bounded source-native numeric parses; UI identity admission remains separate.
parser_review_gate: The 0..100 float domain filter narrows alternate-width decodes; it is not a universal bindict format proof. Review these 55 records before broad automatic import, especially where no independent published rate or recorded tooltip control exists. Unsupported/ambiguous records retain no guessed fields.
unit_and_formula_gate: Native mode-text table names enum1 SEMI, enum2 BURST, enum3 AUTO. Runtime mode selection, interval units, overrides, rounding and final fire rate are established only by separate consumer logic, not by this value packet.
